titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦庄襄王二年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals of Qin for the second year of King Zhuangxiang: Meng Ao's campaign against Zhao and the settling of Taiyuan.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year: the entries for Qin and Chu.
The Hereditary Houses of Yan and of Zhao for this year: Qin's taking of Yuci and thirty-seven Fortresses, told from both sides, and Zhao's army sent to help Wei against Yan.
The passage of the Biography of Lord Chunshen on his fief: the twelve Counties north of the Huai given up for Jiangdong, fifteen years after his enfeoffment, and the old seat of Wu made his own.
The Biography of Meng Tian for this year: his grandfather Meng Ao's campaign against Zhao and the thirty-seven Fortresses.
Ivar the Boneless' commentary on the year: Jing Ji's campaign for Zhao against Yan, with chapter 25 of the Zhanguo Zonghengjia Shu adduced for it, its date unknown.

Ivar the Boneless' second column of commentary on the year: Yan's gift of Hejian to Lü Buwei, the Zhao ministers held in Qin as hostages, and Lian Po's chancellorship, each with his analysis of the source and its date.
